source_policy: Only manifest-bound snapshots, specifications and source evidence.
coverage_policy: Every snapshot; recursive schema types, required/optional, nullable, enum, min/max and additionalProperties; source-backed isolated behavior candidates.
combination_policy: Only declared chains; no arbitrary module/tool Cartesian product. Nested argument combinations vary one constraint at a time; explicit sequences come from implementation.
oracle_policy: JSON Schema validity or explicit implementation-derived expectations; no inferred business error codes, retry or idempotency.
unknown_policy: Preserve unknown; block behavior until contract/runner binding is resolved.
execution_policy: Do not execute Agent, tool handlers, external services or paid models.
freeze_policy: PENDING review; no automatic approval or freeze.
consumer_protocol: nanobot_candidate 1.0; not EvalCase; runtime adapter absent.
